sources.title: ️ Pothole Detection Using YOLO11n - GitHub
sources.snippet: The model uses Transfer Learningwith a pretrained YOLO11n object detection model. The pretrained model was fine-tuned on an annotated pothole dataset containing a single object class: pothole. The trained model was evaluated on a held-out test set and subsequently tested on previously unseen road images and video. 🎯 Detection Class Class Meaning
